doc.name: G — 30s rain-day comfort story set in a megacity night, tender in tone, a pair of rivals, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: rain-day comfort story set in a megacity night, tender in tone
Hero: a pair of rivals
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the rain-day comfort story set in a megacity night, tender in tone form, built around a pair of rivals.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Keep the same time of day across all three acts unless the story's turn requires otherwise — and if it does, state the change explicitly.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a rack focus pulling from foreground occlusion to the subject in Act 1 against a dolly-out that opens the frame into its environment in Act 3 — while holding the near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second rain-day comfort story set in a megacity night, tender in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a whip pan that resolves onto the subject, shot on a 40mm normal at f/2.8, framed with a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a book light bounce producing an extremely soft wrap; grade as a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.

config.negative_prompt: distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second rain-day comfort story set in a megacity night, tender in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a gimbal glide tracking laterally at a constant stand-off, shot on a 58mm vintage double-gauss at f/4, framed with a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation; grade as a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second rain-day comfort story set in a megacity night, tender in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a 180-degree orbit sweeping camera-right, shot on a 24-70mm zoom at the long end at f/1.8, framed with diagonal dynamic balance across the frame.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject; grade as a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, low quality, blown highlights, muddy shadows.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
